label: Pre-encounter — news down the currents
location: The ocean realm, the reef commons

recentEvents.value: Word has come down the currents: ten gates forced, ten guardians fallen and returned, one armed swimmer who answers pleas with a battle cry.
It has begun steering storms off the reefs earlier, and towing the far fishing boats home without being asked.

unresolvedConflicts.value: The hero's road points seaward now. It has carried three hundred ships to safe water and cannot tow the one that matters.

temporaryObjective.value: Brace the reef commons for the day the road opens toward the sea.

notes: Future content (rungs 11+); no quest stages exist yet, so activeQuestStages is empty. News travels between the realms — this is distant awareness, not contact.
